image.alt: A dozen identical small geometric stone microblades laid against a printed centimetre scale, unlabelled.

options.text: Set them in a row along a groove cut into the wood or bone, and fix them with the gum, so that a dozen small edges line up into one long cutting edge.
Use them one at a time as tiny knives held in the fingers, because a sharp edge still cuts.
Grind all twelve together into one large blade.
Throw the blades at an animal one by one, because they are light.
